F6 c>preHi rule not applied because c is a regular-session price. Setup check: active setups up 5%+ on Finviz daily plus names flagged for news in the 13:00Z pass (news not re-checked for all 120). f30c: Form 4 codes and 8-K 3.03/5.03 texts not read (counted as other). relvol null (v111 shows none).
